item.title: Ask HN: Why is the "Who is hiring?" post being re-aged?
item.summary: I noticed that the August 2026 "Who is hiring?" post currently shows it's 1 hour old when opened from the front page. All the comments themselves are also under 1 hour old as well.. But if you check from the whoishiring account submissions it is properly tagged at 8 hours old https://news.ycombinator.com/submitted?id=whoishiring https://imgur.com/a/ZBprWGl Why would comments/posts get re-aged like this? Do any other posts/comments get re-aged? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49163218 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
